title: Combination antiviral treatment for a patient with lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus meningoencephalitis associated with bispecific antibody teclistamab therapy for myeloma
abstract: Lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) is a rare cause of meningoencephalitis in humans. Although LCMV is a rodent zoonosis with a global distribution, no UK cases in humans have been reported in published literature since the 1950s, and testing is rarely performed. LCMV meningoencephalitis is self-limiting in people who are immunocompetent, but infection in hosts who are immunocompromised causes severe disease. We report a presentation of LCMV meningoencephalitis in a patient with relapsed multiple myeloma receiving teclistamab. The patient presented with a 5-month history of progressive neurological symptoms, including hearing loss, ataxia, headache, and weight loss. Cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) analysis showed lymphocytic pleocytosis, markedly elevated protein concentration, and hypoglycorrhachia. Extensive microbiological and autoimmune investigations were negative, and empirical antimicrobial and antituberculosis therapies did not prevent clinical deterioration. Metagenomic next-generation sequencing of CSF identified LCMV, and a history of domestic rodent exposure was subsequently identified. Combination antiviral therapy with ribavirin, remdesivir, and molnupiravir was initiated. Molnupiravir was later substituted for favipiravir, and favipiravir dosing was guided by serum and CSF therapeutic drug monitoring. The patient showed sustained neurological improvement, with clearance of LCMV from CSF and blood within 2 months. Antiviral therapy continued for 6 months. The patient regained functional independence and returned to work, with only mild residual symptoms. In addition to reporting a novel occurrence of LCMV infection in a patient on teclistamab, the case highlights the presence of LCMV in the UK and the utility of metagenomic next-generation sequencing for pathogen identification in undiagnosed encephalitis. Finally, the case provides preliminary evidence supporting combination antiviral therapy in persistent LCMV infection.

title: Clinical Evaluation of the PANDAA Lassa Virus RT-PCR Assay in Sierra Leone
abstract: Abstract Molecular diagnosis of Lassa fever is complicated by extensive Lassa virus genetic diversity and limited laboratory capacity in endemic settings. The RealStar(C) Lassa Virus RT-PCR Kit 2.0 is a commonly used commercial dual-target assay for LASV detection, but its two-target format requires separate amplification reactions, increasing reagent use and workflow complexity. We present the diagnostic evaluation of the single-reaction, adaptive PANDAA Lassa Virus RT-PCR assay with the dual-target RealStar(C) Lassa Virus RT-PCR Kit 2.0 using 94 archived serum samples from Sierra Leone. 79 of these samples had valid paired results, and we report a positive percent agreement of 78.12% (95% CI 61.25%-88.98%), negative percent agreement of 93.62% (95% CI 82.84%-97.81%), and an overall agreement of 87.34% (95% CI 78.24%-92.98%); Cohen k; was 0.73 (95% CI 0.58-0.89). PANDAA showed substantial agreement and offers a potentially efficient single-well format, but further optimisation and prospective evaluation are needed.

title: Diagnostic accuracy of a single-reaction, pan-lineage Lassa virus RT-PCR at two Nigerian laboratories: a retrospective and prospective cohort study
abstract: Background Lassa virus (LASV) intra- and inter-lineage nucleotide diversity has made it challenging to develop a single-reaction RT-PCR assay that can detect all viral variants with equal sensitivity. We evaluated PANDAA(R) LASV, a single-reaction pan-lineage RT-PCR assay, at two Nigerian Lassa fever laboratories against the RealStar(R) Lassa Virus RT-PCR Kit 2.0, the current diagnostic standard in Nigeria, which requires two separate reactions per patient sample to mitigate against false negative results. Methodology and Principal Findings We conducted a diagnostic accuracy study using retrospectively (n = 200) and prospectively (n = 100) plasma samples that had been collected from patients meeting the standard case definition of suspected Lassa fever for testing by real-time PCR at Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University Teaching Hospital in Bauchi and Federal Medical Centre in Owo. PANDAA LASV(R) sensitivity was 98.6% (138/140; 95% CI 94.9-99.8%), specificity 99.4% (155/156; 96.5-100%), and accuracy 99.0% (293/296; 97.1-99.8%). The positive likelihood ratio was 153.8 (21.8-1084.9) and the negative likelihood ratio 0.01 (0.00-0.06). PANDAA Ct values correlated significantly with the reference assay L gene target (Spearman's {rho} = 0.80; p < 0.0001) and GPC target ({rho} = 0.69; p < 0.0001). Three confirmed discordant results occurred at high Ct values near assay detection limits. Performance was consistent across sites with overlapping confidence intervals for sensitivity and specificity and no difference in median Ct values for any assay target between laboratories. Ct values were significantly lower in patients [≥] 45 years (p = 0.008). Conclusions and Significance PANDAA(R) LASV demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy to detect Lassa virus RNA compared to the dual-reaction reference assay. Reducing the operational burden from two PCR reactions per sample to a single PANDAA(R) LASV reaction while maintaining equivalent sensitivity and specificity could have a direct impact on labour and reagent costs, and turnaround time. Clinical validation against additional LASV lineages is an immediate priority.

title_zh: 单反应、全谱系拉沙病毒RT-PCR在尼日利亚两家实验室的诊断准确性:一项回顾性与前瞻性队列研究研究
source_body_en: Background Lassa virus (LASV) intra- and inter-lineage nucleotide diversity has made it challenging to develop a single-reaction RT-PCR assay that can detect all viral variants with equal sensitivity. We evaluated PANDAA(R) LASV, a single-reaction pan-lineage RT-PCR assay, at two Nigerian Lassa fever laboratories against the RealStar(R) Lassa Virus RT-PCR Kit 2.0, the current diagnostic standard in Nigeria, which requires two separate reactions per patient sample to mitigate against false negative results. Methodology and Principal Findings We conducted a diagnostic accuracy study using retrospectively (n = 200) and prospectively (n = 100) plasma samples that had been collected from patients meeting the standard case definition of suspected Lassa fever for testing by real-time PCR at Abubakar Tafawa Balewa University Teaching Hospital in Bauchi and Federal Medical Centre in Owo. PANDAA LASV(R) sensitivity was 98.6% (138/140; 95% CI 94.9-99.8%), specificity 99.4% (155/156; 96.5-100%), and accuracy 99.0% (293/296; 97.1-99.8%). The positive likelihood ratio was 153.8 (21.8-1084.9) and the negative likelihood ratio 0.01 (0.00-0.06). PANDAA Ct values correlated significantly with the reference assay L gene target (Spearman's {rho} = 0.80; p < 0.0001) and GPC target ({rho} = 0.69; p < 0.0001). Three confirmed discordant results occurred at high Ct values near assay detection limits. Performance was consistent across sites with overlapping confidence intervals for sensitivity and specificity and no difference in median Ct values for any assay target between laboratories. Ct values were significantly lower in patients [≥] 45 years (p = 0.008). Conclusions and Significance PANDAA(R) LASV demonstrated high diagnostic accuracy to detect Lassa virus RNA compared to the dual-reaction reference assay. Reducing the operational burden from two PCR reactions per sample to a single PANDAA(R) LASV reaction while maintaining equivalent sensitivity and specificity could have a direct impact on labour and reagent costs, and turnaround time. Clinical validation against additional LASV lineages is an immediate priority.
abstract_zh: 背景 拉沙病毒(LASV)的谱系内和谱系间核苷酸多样性使得开发一种能够以同等灵敏度检测所有病毒变体的单反应RT-PCR检测方法变得具有挑战性。我们评估了PANDAA(R) LASV,一种单反应全谱系RT-PCR检测方法,在尼日利亚两家拉沙热实验室中与当前诊断标准RealStar(R) 拉沙病毒RT-PCR试剂盒2.0的比较结果,该试剂盒需要对每个患者样本进行两次独立反应以减少假阴性结果的风险。方法与主要发现 我们在回顾性(n = 200)和前瞻性(n = 100)的血浆样本中开展了一项诊断准确性研究,这些样本来自符合拉沙热标准病例定义的疑似拉沙热患者,并在Bauchi的Abubakar Tafawa Balewa大学教学医院和Owo的联邦医疗中心通过实时PCR进行检测。PANDAA LASV的灵敏度为98.6%(138/140;95% CI 94.9-99.8%),特异性为99.4%(155/156;96.5-100%),准确度为99.0%(293/296;97.1-99.8%)。阳性似然比为153.8(21.8-1084.9),阴性似然比为0.01(0.00-0.06)。PANDAA的Ct值与参考检测方法L基因靶标(Spearman's {rho} = 0.80;p < 0.0001)和GPC靶标({rho} = 0.69;p < 0.0001)显著相关。在高Ct值接近检测限的区域出现了三个确认的不一致结果。在不同实验室之间,灵敏度和特异性的表现一致,且置信区间重叠,且任何检测靶标在不同实验室之间的中位Ct值均无差异。年龄≥45岁的患者Ct值显著较低(p = 0.008)。结论与意义 PANDAA(R) LASV在检测拉沙病毒RNA方面表现出高诊断准确性,与双反应参考检测方法相比。将每样本从两次PCR反应减少为一次PANDAA(R) LASV反应,同时保持同等的灵敏度和特异性,可能对劳动和试剂成本以及检测周转时间产生直接影响。在更多拉沙病毒谱系中进行临床验证是当务之急。

title: Effects of dietary iron restriction on Junín virus disease in a humanized transferrin receptor 1 mouse model
abstract: Five New World mammarenaviruses (NWM) cause severe hemorrhagic fever and threaten human health in South American communities where they are endemic. No FDA-approved antiviral drugs exist to treat these viral infections, and treatment options are urgently needed. Laboratory mice genetically modified to express human transferrin receptor 1 (huTfR1 Tg mice) are susceptible to Junín virus (JUNV), which, like other pathogenic NWMs, enters cells by attaching to the receptor’s apical domain. However, these mice exhibit physiological abnormalities, thereby limiting the model’s utility. In contrast, transgenic mice that express a murine TfR1 with a human apical domain (huApTfR1 Tg mice) are physiologically normal but more refractory to JUNV disease. Here, we investigated whether dietary iron restriction increases huApTfR1 expression, thereby promoting greater JUNV entry and more severe disease in response to reduced iron bioavailability. While a significant increase in huApTfR1 expression in target tissues was observed in mice raised on a low-iron diet, it did not confer greater susceptibility to severe JUNV disease. Notably, the low-iron diet resulted in iron-deficiency anemia and significantly lower body weight in the mice. Although our findings indicate that dietary iron restriction upregulates huApTfR1 expression and induces iron-deficiency anemia, it does not enhance mortality following JUNV challenge.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether dietary iron restriction increases huApTfR1 expression, thereby promoting greater JUNV entry and more severe disease in response to reduced iron bioavailability. This research addresses the need for new treatment options for severe hemorrhagic fever caused by New World mammarenaviruses, which currently lack FDA-approved antiviral drugs.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used transgenic mice expressing a human transferrin receptor 1 (huApTfR1 Tg mice) that are physiologically normal but more refractory to JUNV disease. The research was conducted to understand the effects of dietary iron restriction on these mice and their susceptibility to Junín virus (JUNV) infection.
analysis.methods: The study involved raising mice on a low-iron diet to observe changes in huApTfR1 expression and the impact on JUNV disease. The methods included dietary manipulation, molecular biology techniques to measure huApTfR1 expression, and viral challenge experiments to assess disease severity.
analysis.main_results: While a significant increase in huApTfR1 expression was observed in target tissues in mice raised on a low-iron diet, this did not confer greater susceptibility to severe JUNV disease. The low-iron diet resulted in iron-deficiency anemia and significantly lower body weight in the mice.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that dietary iron restriction upregulates huApTfR1 expression and induces iron-deficiency anemia but does not enhance mortality following JUNV challenge. This finding suggests that targeting huApTfR1 expression alone may not be sufficient to increase JUNV susceptibility.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings caution against the use of dietary iron restriction as a strategy to enhance JUNV susceptibility in huApTfR1 Tg mice. They highlight the need for further research into other potential targets or strategies to improve the utility of this mouse model for studying JUNV disease.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limitations include the use of a specific mouse model that may not fully represent human physiology. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited sample size and the need for further validation in human-relevant models.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated whether dietary iron restriction increases huApTfR1 expression and promotes JUNV disease in mice. While huApTfR1 expression increased, the mice did not exhibit greater susceptibility to severe JUNV disease, indicating that targeting this receptor alone may not be effective.

elements_zh.methods: 本研究通过饲养小鼠在低铁饮食下,观察huApTfR1表达的变化及其对JUNV疾病的影响。方法包括饮食干预、分子生物学技术测量huApTfR1表达水平,以及病毒挑战实验评估疾病严重程度。
elements_zh.main_results: 虽然在低铁饮食饲养的小鼠中观察到靶组织中huApTfR1表达显著增加,但并未导致对严重JUNV疾病的更高易感性。低铁饮食导致小鼠出现缺铁性贫血和显著降低的体重。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者认为饮食铁限制可以上调huApTfR1表达并诱导缺铁性贫血,但不会增强死亡率在JUNV挑战后的表现。这一发现表明,仅针对huApTfR1表达可能不足以提高JUNV的易感性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现警示人们不应将饮食铁限制作为增强huApTfR1 Tg小鼠对JUNV易感性的策略。它们强调了进一步研究其他潜在靶点或策略的必要性,以提高该小鼠模型在研究JUNV疾病中的实用性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用了特定的小鼠模型,可能无法完全代表人类生理。由于样本量有限,证据强度中等,需要在更贴近人类的模型中进一步验证。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate whether dietary iron restriction increases huApTfR1 expression, thereby promoting greater JUNV entry and more severe disease in response to reduced iron bioavailability. This research addresses the need for new treatment options for severe hemorrhagic fever caused by New World mammarenaviruses, which currently lack FDA-approved antiviral drugs.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: The study used transgenic mice expressing a human transferrin receptor 1 (huApTfR1 Tg mice) that are physiologically normal but more refractory to JUNV disease. The research was conducted to understand the effects of dietary iron restriction on these mice and their susceptibility to Junín virus (JUNV) infection.
analysis_en.methods: The study involved raising mice on a low-iron diet to observe changes in huApTfR1 expression and the impact on JUNV disease. The methods included dietary manipulation, molecular biology techniques to measure huApTfR1 expression, and viral challenge experiments to assess disease severity.
analysis_en.main_results: While a significant increase in huApTfR1 expression was observed in target tissues in mice raised on a low-iron diet, this did not confer greater susceptibility to severe JUNV disease. The low-iron diet resulted in iron-deficiency anemia and significantly lower body weight in the mice.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that dietary iron restriction upregulates huApTfR1 expression and induces iron-deficiency anemia but does not enhance mortality following JUNV challenge. This finding suggests that targeting huApTfR1 expression alone may not be sufficient to increase JUNV susceptibility.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings caution against the use of dietary iron restriction as a strategy to enhance JUNV susceptibility in huApTfR1 Tg mice. They highlight the need for further research into other potential targets or strategies to improve the utility of this mouse model for studying JUNV disease.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s limitations include the use of a specific mouse model that may not fully represent human physiology. The evidence strength is moderate due to the limited sample size and the need for further validation in human-relevant models.

title_zh: 饮食铁限制对人源化转铁蛋白受体1小鼠模型中Junín病毒病的影响
source_body_en: Five New World mammarenaviruses (NWM) cause severe hemorrhagic fever and threaten human health in South American communities where they are endemic. No FDA-approved antiviral drugs exist to treat these viral infections, and treatment options are urgently needed. Laboratory mice genetically modified to express human transferrin receptor 1 (huTfR1 Tg mice) are susceptible to Junín virus (JUNV), which, like other pathogenic NWMs, enters cells by attaching to the receptor’s apical domain. However, these mice exhibit physiological abnormalities, thereby limiting the model’s utility. In contrast, transgenic mice that express a murine TfR1 with a human apical domain (huApTfR1 Tg mice) are physiologically normal but more refractory to JUNV disease. Here, we investigated whether dietary iron restriction increases huApTfR1 expression, thereby promoting greater JUNV entry and more severe disease in response to reduced iron bioavailability. While a significant increase in huApTfR1 expression in target tissues was observed in mice raised on a low-iron diet, it did not confer greater susceptibility to severe JUNV disease. Notably, the low-iron diet resulted in iron-deficiency anemia and significantly lower body weight in the mice. Although our findings indicate that dietary iron restriction upregulates huApTfR1 expression and induces iron-deficiency anemia, it does not enhance mortality following JUNV challenge.
abstract_zh: 五种新世界哺乳动物沙粒病毒(NWM)会引起严重的出血热,并威胁南美洲流行地区的人类健康。目前尚无美国食品药品监督管理局(FDA)批准的抗病毒药物用于治疗这些病毒感染,亟需开发新的治疗方案。基因工程改造的实验室小鼠,其表达人类转铁蛋白受体1(huTfR1 Tg小鼠),对Junín病毒(JUNV)易感,与其他致病性NWM类似,JUNV通过结合受体的顶端结构域进入细胞。然而,这些小鼠表现出生理异常,从而限制了该模型的实用性。相比之下,表达具有人类顶端结构域的鼠类转铁蛋白受体1(huApTfR1 Tg小鼠)的转基因小鼠生理正常,但对JUNV疾病更为抵抗。本研究探讨了饮食铁限制是否能增加huApTfR1的表达,从而促进JUNV在铁生物利用度降低时的更多进入和更严重的疾病。虽然在低铁饮食饲养的小鼠中观察到靶组织中huApTfR1表达显著增加,但并未导致对严重JUNV疾病的更高易感性。值得注意的是,低铁饮食导致小鼠出现缺铁性贫血和显著降低的体重。尽管我们的研究结果表明饮食铁限制可以上调huApTfR1表达并诱导缺铁性贫血,但它并未增强死亡率在JUNV挑战后的表现。

title: Immunoinformatics-Driven Multi-Epitope Vaccine Design Against Junin virus Using Whole-Proteome Analysis and Immune Simulation
abstract: Junin virus (JUNV) is a causative agent of Argentine Hemorrhagic Fever (AHF) in humans (especially in farmers) with no long-term approved antiviral therapeutics. We developed a multi-epitope vaccine against JUNV using an immunoinformatics approach comprising sequence retrieval, epitope prediction, vaccine design and analysis, molecular docking, MD simulations, immune simulation, and in silico cloning. Moreover, we evaluate six Cytotoxic T-Lymphocytes (CTL), four Helper T-Lymphocytes (HTL), and four Linear B-Lymphocytes (LBL) potential epitopes with high antigenicity, no allergenicity, outside membrane, and no toxicity. The vaccine was linked by β-defensin 3 and a PADRE sequence at both termini and multiple structural linkers (M, EAAAK, TAT, SSL, GGGS, GGGGS, KK) to ensure stability and proper epitope spacing. The designed vaccine showed a worldwide population coverage (98.83%), antigenic (0.8295) non-allergenic, outside membrane, and non-toxic. Additionally, structural assessment showed an ERRAT score of 94.758%, with 93.8% residues in the favored region of the Ramachandran plot and a ProSA Z-score of -6.3. Additionally, molecular docking reveals the vaccine’s favorable predicted binding affinity score with human TLR2 (-194.2) than human TLR4 (-125.5 ± 2.6), whereas MD simulation with 100ns indicates stable behavior both structural dynamic complexes. Finally, immune simulation predicted enhanced humoral and cellular responses, with peak IFN-γ and IL-4 concentrations of approximately 400,000 and 120,000 ng/mL, respectively, while in silico cloning indicated favorable predicted expression feasibility in E. coli expression of the vaccine. Furthermore, the vaccine shows potential immunity against JUNV, whether in vitro or in vivo studies are necessary to confirm its efficacy.

analysis.summary_en: This study presents an immunoinformatics-driven multi-epitope vaccine design against Junin virus (JUNV), the causative agent of Argentine Hemorrhagic Fever (AHF). The vaccine was developed using sequence retrieval, epitope prediction, molecular docking, MD simulations, immune simulation, and in silico cloning. The results indicate that the vaccine has high worldwide population coverage, is antigenic, non-allergenic, outside membrane, and non-toxic. Structural assessment showed favorable properties with an ERRAT score of 94.758%, 93.8% residues in the favored region of the Ramachandran plot, and a ProSA Z-score of -6.3. The vaccine's predicted binding affinity with human TLR2 was higher than with TLR4, and immune simulation suggested enhanced humoral and cellular responses. The authors concluded that the vaccine shows potential immunity against JUNV, though further in vitro or in vivo studies are needed to confirm its efficacy. The study's evidence is moderate due to its reliance on computational methods without experimental validation.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,该疫苗可能是预防阿根廷出血热的有前景的候选药物,为监测、诊断以及未来疫苗的发展提供了潜在方向。

abstract_zh: Junin病毒(JUNV)是人类(尤其是农民)阿根廷出血热(AHF)的病原体,目前尚无长期批准的抗病毒药物治疗药物。我们采用免疫信息学方法设计了一种针对JUNV的多表位疫苗,包括序列检索、表位预测、疫苗设计与分析、分子对接、分子动力学(MD)模拟、免疫模拟以及体外克隆。此外,我们评估了六个细胞毒性T淋巴细胞(CTL)表位、四个辅助性T淋巴细胞(HTL)表位和四个线性B淋巴细胞(LBL)表位,这些表位具有高抗原性、无致敏性、位于细胞膜外且无毒性。该疫苗在两端通过β-防御素3和PADRE序列连接,并使用多个结构连接子(M、EAAAK、TAT、SSL、GGGS、GGGGS、KK)以确保其稳定性和表位间距的适当性。设计的疫苗表现出全球人口覆盖率(98.83%)、抗原性(0.8295)、无致敏性、位于细胞膜外且无毒性的特性。此外,结构评估显示其ERRAT得分为94.758%,Ramachandran图中93.8%的残基位于有利区域,ProSA Z-score为-6.3。此外,分子对接显示该疫苗与人类TLR2的预测结合亲和力得分(-194.2)优于与人类TLR4的结合亲和力得分(-125.5 ± 2.6),而100ns的MD模拟表明该结构动态复合物表现出稳定行为。最后,免疫模拟预测了增强的体液和细胞免疫应答,IFN-γ和IL-4浓度分别达到约400,000和120,000 ng/mL。体外克隆表明该疫苗在大肠杆菌中具有良好的表达可行性。此外,该疫苗显示出对JUNV的潜在免疫作用,但需要进行体外或体内研究以确认其有效性。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: Junin病毒(JUNV)是人类(尤其是农民)阿根廷出血热(AHF)的病原体,目前尚无长期批准的抗病毒药物治疗药物。本研究旨在利用免疫信息学方法设计一种针对JUNV的多表位疫苗。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究采用免疫信息学方法,包括序列检索、表位预测、疫苗设计与分析、分子对接、分子动力学(MD)模拟、免疫模拟以及体外克隆。评估了疫苗的特性,如抗原性、致敏性、膜定位和毒性。
analysis_zh.methods: 该疫苗采用免疫信息学方法设计,包括序列检索、表位预测和分析。其两端通过β-防御素3和PADRE序列连接,并使用多个结构连接子以确保其稳定性和表位间距的适当性。通过分子对接和分子动力学(MD)模拟评估了疫苗的结构和动态行为。
analysis_zh.main_results: 设计的疫苗表现出全球人口覆盖率(98.83%)、抗原性(0.8295)、无致敏性、位于细胞膜外且无毒性的特性。结构评估显示其ERRAT得分为94.758%,Ramachandran图中93.8%的残基位于有利区域,ProSA Z-score为-6.3。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为该疫苗具有针对JUNV的潜在免疫特性。其创新之处在于利用免疫信息学驱动的多表位疫苗设计方法针对JUNV。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,该疫苗可能是预防阿根廷出血热的有前景的候选药物,为监测、诊断以及未来疫苗的发展提供了潜在方向。

title: Viral Infection Across the Kidney Transplant Continuum: Screening, Prevention, Management, and Oncogenesis
abstract: Viral infections influence every stage of the kidney transplantation continuum, shaping immunologic risk, graft outcomes, and long term patient survival. Pre transplant serologic assessments guide critical decisions, including vaccinations, the avoidance of lymphocyte depleting induction in Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) mismatched candidates and the selection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) prophylaxis tailored to donor–recipient serostatus. Acceptance of hepatitis C viremic donor organs has significantly reduced wait times, while human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positive donor organs remain restricted to HIV positive recipients. Post transplant, viral pathogens are major drivers of morbidity: CMV functions as an immunomodulator that increases susceptibility to rejection and opportunistic fungal infections, and routine surveillance for CMV and BK viremia is essential, especially following rejection therapies. BK virus nephropathy, adenovirus nephropathy, and JC virus nephropathy can lead to progressive allograft dysfunction. Additionally, COVID 19 and parvovirus infections have been associated with collapsing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) and severe graft injury. Persistent viral infections and virus associated glomerulopathies contribute to chronic graft loss, while EBV driven post transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD) remains a significant cause of cancer related mortality. Transplant recipients are also at increased risk for persistent human papillomavirus infection (HPV) and progression to anogenital and oropharyngeal malignancies. Finally, donor derived viral infections, including rabies, West Nile virus (WNV), and lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV), though rare, are well described in the literature. Collectively, these viral complications substantially impact morbidity, graft survival, and overall mortality in kidney transplant recipients.

abstract_original: Viral infections influence every stage of the kidney transplantation continuum, shaping immunologic risk, graft outcomes, and long term patient survival. Pre transplant serologic assessments guide critical decisions, including vaccinations, the avoidance of lymphocyte depleting induction in Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) mismatched candidates and the selection of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) prophylaxis tailored to donor–recipient serostatus. Acceptance of hepatitis C viremic donor organs has significantly reduced wait times, while human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) positive donor organs remain restricted to HIV positive recipients. Post transplant, viral pathogens are major drivers of morbidity: CMV functions as an immunomodulator that increases susceptibility to rejection and opportunistic fungal infections, and routine surveillance for CMV and BK viremia is essential, especially following rejection therapies. BK virus nephropathy, adenovirus nephropathy, and JC virus nephropathy can lead to progressive allograft dysfunction. Additionally, COVID 19 and parvovirus infections have been associated with collapsing focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) and severe graft injury. Persistent viral infections and virus associated glomerulopathies contribute to chronic graft loss, while EBV driven post transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (PTLD) remains a significant cause of cancer related mortality. Transplant recipients are also at increased risk for persistent human papillomavirus infection (HPV) and progression to anogenital and oropharyngeal malignancies. Finally, donor derived viral infections, including rabies, West Nile virus (WNV), and lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV), though rare, are well described in the literature. Collectively, these viral complications substantially impact morbidity, graft survival, and overall mortality in kidney transplant recipients.
title_original: Viral Infection Across the Kidney Transplant Continuum: Screening, Prevention, Management, and Oncogenesis

abstract_zh: 病毒感染影响肾脏移植全过程的每个阶段,影响免疫学风险、移植物结局和长期患者生存率。移植前的血清学检测指导关键决策,包括疫苗接种、避免在EBV不匹配的供体中使用淋巴细胞耗竭诱导治疗以及根据供体-受体血清状态选择CMV预防方案。接受丙型肝炎病毒(HCV)血清阳性供体器官显著缩短了等待时间,而人类免疫缺陷病毒(HIV)阳性供体器官仍仅限于HIV阳性受体。移植后,病毒病原体是主要的发病率驱动因素:CMV作为一种免疫调节剂,会增加排斥反应和机会性真菌感染的易感性,且对CMV和BK病毒血症进行常规监测至关重要,尤其是在接受排斥治疗后。BK病毒肾病、腺病毒肾病和JC病毒肾病可能导致进行性移植物功能障碍。此外,冠状病毒(COVID 19)和细小病毒感染与进行性局灶节段性肾小球硬化(FSGS)和严重移植物损伤有关。持续性病毒感染和病毒相关性肾小球病会导致慢性移植物丢失,而EBV驱动的移植后淋巴增殖性疾病(PTLD)仍是与癌症相关的死亡率的重要原因。移植受体还面临持续性人乳头瘤病毒(HPV)感染以及发展为生殖道和口咽恶性肿瘤的更高风险。最后,来自供体的病毒感染,包括狂犬病、西尼罗河病毒(WNV)和淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV),虽然罕见,但在文献中已有详细描述。总体而言,这些病毒并发症显著影响移植受体的发病率、移植物存活率和整体死亡率。

title: 773 Identification of novel therapeutic targets on tumor-infiltrating regulatory T cells using an in vivo CRISPR screening system
abstract: Background Regulatory T (Treg) cells are abundant in tumor tissues and play key roles in facilitating immune evasion by tumor cells. Targeting tumor-infiltrating Treg cells specifically while sparing peripheral Treg cells is a promising strategy in immunotherapy. In this study, we employed in vivo CRISPR screening to identify novel regulators of tumor-infiltrating Treg cell abundance.Methods Monoclonal SMARTA Treg cells specific to glycoprotein (GP) 61–80 of lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) were used in screening. To increase the number of thymus-derived SMARTA Treg cells in TCR-transgenic mice, expression of full-length LCMV-GP driven by the rat insulin promoter and administration of IL-2 complexes were utilized. The library was constructed to target 34 candidate genes that are more highly expressed in tumor-infiltrating Treg cells than in peripheral Treg cells. Cas9-expressing SMARTA Treg cells were isolated and retrovirally transduced with guide RNAs targeting candidate genes. Transduced SMARTA Treg cells were then adoptively transferred to mice bearing MC38 tumors overexpressing LCMV-GP. A portion of the transduced SMARTA Treg cells was retained as the input control. SMARTA Treg cells were recovered from tumors fourteen days after adoptive transfer. Genomic DNA was extracted and subjected to sequencing, with sgRNA abundance as the readout. To establish the in vivo suppression model, P14 CD8+ T cells recognizing the LCMV-GP33–41 epitope were co-transferred with SMARTA Treg cells, with tumor growth as the readout (figure 1).Results Antigen expression and IL-2 complex treatment increased SMARTA Treg cell numbers by more than fivefold. The suppressive function of transferred SMARTA Treg cells was demonstrated by restoration of tumor growth that had been inhibited by adoptively transferred P14 CD8 + T cells (P 2,000 transferred SMARTA Treg cells per tumor, achieving coverage of >500 cells/gene. In vivo CRISPR screening using the library revealed that several known Treg cell regulators, including Il2ra and Icos, were among the top hits, validating the model. In addition, Rgs16 (Log[fold-change] = -1.06) and Anxa2 (Log[fold-change] = -0.77) emerged as candidate regulators of Treg cell abundance.Conclusions We established an in vivo CRISPR screening platform to identify novel therapeutic targets in tumor-infiltrating Treg cells for improving immunotherapy outcomes. In parallel with the CRISPR screen, an in vivo suppression assay was developed to validate the function of individual genes. Rgs16 and Anxa2 were identified as candidate targets for the selective depletion of tumor-infiltrating Treg cells.Ethics Approval Animal protocols were approved by the Institutional Animal Care and Use Committees of University of Pittsburgh under 24034595.Abstract 773 Figure 1In vivo CRISPR screening model for tumor-infiltrating Treg cells

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify novel therapeutic targets on tumor-infiltrating regulatory T cells to improve immunotherapy outcomes. The researchers employed an in vivo CRISPR screening system using monoclonal SMARTA Treg cells specific to glycoprotein (GP) 61–80 of lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) to explore gene regulation in these cells. They increased the number of SMARTA Treg cells in TCR-transgenic mice by expressing full-length LCMV-GP and administering IL-2 complexes. The CRISPR library targeted 34 genes more highly expressed in tumor-infiltrating Treg cells than in peripheral Treg cells. SMARTA Treg cells were adoptively transferred to mice bearing MC38 tumors overexpressing LCMV-GP, and genomic DNA was sequenced to measure sgRNA abundance. The results showed that antigen expression and IL-2 complex treatment increased SMARTA Treg cell numbers by more than fivefold, and known Treg regulators like Il2ra and Icos were among the top hits, validating the model. Additionally, Rgs16 and Anxa2 were identified as candidate regulators of Treg cell abundance. The study provides a platform for identifying therapeutic targets in tumor-infiltrating Treg cells, which could enhance immunotherapy strategies. However, the evidence does not report limitations or evidence strength.

abstract_zh: 背景 肿瘤组织中调节性T(Treg)细胞数量丰富,并在促进肿瘤细胞免疫逃逸中发挥关键作用。在免疫治疗中,特异性靶向肿瘤浸润的Treg细胞同时保留外周Treg细胞是一个有前景的策略。在本研究中,我们采用体内CRISPR筛选技术,以鉴定肿瘤浸润Treg细胞数量的新调控因子。方法 使用单克隆SMARTA Treg细胞进行筛选,这些细胞特异性识别淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV)的糖蛋白(GP)61–80表位。为增加TCR转基因小鼠中胸腺来源的SMARTA Treg细胞数量,利用大鼠胰岛素启动子驱动的全长LCMV-GP表达和IL-2复合物的给药。构建了一个靶向34个候选基因的文库,这些基因在肿瘤浸润Treg细胞中的表达水平高于外周Treg细胞。分离表达Cas9的SMARTA Treg细胞,并用靶向候选基因的引导RNA进行逆转录病毒转导。转导后的SMARTA Treg细胞随后被转移到携带过表达LCMV-GP的MC38肿瘤小鼠体内。一部分转导的SMARTA Treg细胞作为输入对照保留。在体外转移14天后,从小鼠肿瘤中回收SMARTA Treg细胞。提取基因组DNA并进行测序,以sgRNA丰度作为读数。为了建立体内抑制模型,将识别LCMV-GP33–41表位的P14 CD8+ T细胞与SMARTA Treg细胞共同转移,以肿瘤生长作为读数(图1)。结果 抗原表达和IL-2复合物治疗使SMARTA Treg细胞数量增加了五倍以上。转移的SMARTA Treg细胞的抑制功能通过恢复由体外转移的P14 CD8+ T细胞抑制的肿瘤生长得以证明(每肿瘤转移2,000个SMARTA Treg细胞,实现>500个细胞/基因的覆盖)。利用该文库进行的体内CRISPR筛选显示,包括Il2ra和Icos在内的多个已知Treg细胞调控因子位列前茅,验证了该模型。此外,Rgs16(Log[fold-change] = -1.06)和Anxa2(Log[fold-change] = -0.77)被鉴定为Treg细胞数量的候选调控因子。结论 我们建立了一个体内CRISPR筛选平台,以识别肿瘤浸润Treg细胞中的新型治疗靶点,从而改善免疫治疗效果。与CRISPR筛选同时进行,还开发了一种体内抑制试验,以验证单个基因的功能。Rgs16和Anxa2被鉴定为选择性清除肿瘤浸润Treg细胞的候选靶点。伦理批准 本研究的动物实验方案已获得匹兹堡大学机构动物护理与使用委员会的批准(编号:24034595)。摘要 773 图1 肿瘤浸润Treg细胞的体内CRISPR筛选模型

title: 778 CD7 signaling regulates survival of exhausted CD8 T cells
abstract: Background CD8 + T cell exhaustion is a major barrier to durable immune responses in cancer and chronic infection. Persistent antigen stimulation through the T cell receptor drives inhibitory receptor expression and enforces a stable epigenetic and transcriptional program that limits effector function and survival. Despite many implicated inhibitory and co-stimulatory receptors, the mechanisms sustaining terminally exhausted CD8+ T cells across distinct tissue environments remain incompletely understood.Methods Using the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) model of chronic infection and multiple subcutaneous tumor models, we assessed CD7 expression and function through Cd7 deletion and overexpression, spectral flow cytometric phenotyping, bulk transcriptional profiling, and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) of antigen-specific CD8+ T cells.Results We have previously shown that CD7 is progressively upregulated during CD8 T cell differentiation in chronically infected mice and and is most pronounced on a distinct subset of terminally exhausted CD8 + T cells in the liver, a tissue where exhausted cells persist despite high antigen load. Conditional deletion of Cd7 during chronic infection markedly reduces the persistence and increases the apoptotic susceptibility of antigen-specific CD8+ T cells. Functionally, germline Cd7 deletion impaired control of LCMV clone 13 infection within the liver, underscoring the context-dependent requirement for CD7 in sustaining antiviral CD8+ T cell responses. To examine the signaling requirement for CD7 during terminal differentiation, we restored CD7 signaling on Cd7-/- CD8 T cells using retroviral overexpression and compared wild type CD7 to CD7 with phosphomimemtic mutations of key amino acids. Wild-type CD7 signaling improved persistence via reduced susceptibility to apoptosis, and increased expression of granzyme A and granzyme B, underscoring CD7’s importance in maintaining cytotoxic subsets of terminally exhausted CD8 T cells.Conclusions These data further explore the function of CD7 in maintaining the persistence of terminally exhausted CD8 + T cells during chronic antigen exposure. They broaden understanding of how co-receptors regulate exhaustion dynamics and suggest that targeting the CD7 axis could enhance T cell persistence and function in chronic infection and cancer immunotherapy.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the role of CD7 in maintaining the persistence of terminally exhausted CD8+ T cells during chronic antigen exposure. Using the lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) model and subcutaneous tumor models, the researchers assessed CD7 expression and function through genetic manipulation and advanced sequencing techniques. They found that CD7 deletion reduces T cell persistence and increases apoptosis, while wild-type CD7 signaling enhances survival and cytotoxic function. These results highlight CD7's importance in sustaining antiviral CD8+ T cell responses and suggest potential therapeutic strategies for chronic infections and cancer immunotherapy. However, the study's reliance on in vivo models limits its generalizability, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.

abstract_zh: 背景 CD8+ T细胞耗竭是癌症和慢性感染中持久免疫应答的主要障碍。通过T细胞受体持续抗原刺激驱动抑制性受体的表达,并强制执行稳定的表观遗传和转录程序,从而限制效应功能和存活。尽管已知许多抑制性和共刺激性受体,但维持不同组织环境中终末耗竭CD8+ T细胞的机制仍不完全清楚。方法 使用淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV)慢性感染模型和多种皮下肿瘤模型,我们通过Cd7基因敲除和过表达、光谱流式细胞术表型分析、抗原特异性CD8+ T细胞的批量转录组分析以及单细胞RNA测序(scRNA-seq)评估CD7的表达和功能。结果 我们之前已证明,在慢性感染小鼠中CD8 T细胞分化过程中CD7会逐渐上调,并且在肝脏中,一种终末耗竭CD8+ T细胞的亚群中最为显著,肝脏是耗竭细胞即使在高抗原负荷下仍能持续存在的组织。在慢性感染期间条件性敲除Cd7显著降低了抗原特异性CD8+ T细胞的持续存在,并增加了其凋亡敏感性。功能上,germline Cd7敲除损害了肝脏中LCMV克隆13感染的控制,突显了CD7在维持抗病毒药物 CD8+ T细胞应答中的情境依赖性需求。为了研究CD7在终末分化期间的信号需求,研究人员通过逆转录病毒过表达恢复Cd7-/- CD8 T细胞上的CD7信号,并将野生型CD7与具有关键氨基酸磷酸模拟突变的CD7进行比较。野生型CD7信号通过减少凋亡敏感性提高了持续存在,同时增加了颗粒酶A和颗粒酶B的表达,突显了CD7在维持终末耗竭CD8 T细胞的细胞毒性亚群中的重要性。结论 这些数据进一步探讨了CD7在慢性抗原暴露期间维持终末耗竭CD8+ T细胞持续存在中的功能。它们拓宽了对共受体如何调控耗竭动态的理解,并表明靶向CD7轴可能增强慢性感染和癌症免疫治疗中的T细胞持续存在和功能。

title: Development of Heterocyclic Small Molecule Antiviral Entry Inhibitors
abstract: There is an urgent need to develop novel antiviral therapeutics to address the growing threat posed by viruses. Small-molecule inhibitors of viral entry are attractive antiviral agents because they block the virus at its earliest step, preventing the virus from entering host cells and causing downstream damage. Some of the viruses of greatest concern for human health, such as human immunodeficiency virus, respiratory syncytial virus, influenza virus, Ebola virus, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2, and Lassa virus, encode Class 1 fusion proteins which mediate membrane fusion and viral entry. In this dissertation, we highlight recent advances in the discovery and development of small-molecule entry inhibitors reported over the past five years that target viruses encoding Class 1 fusion proteins. Additionally, we report thieno[3,2-b]pyrroles as novel Group 2 influenza A virus entry inhibitors. Lastly, we report the further optimization of the raloxifene‐inspired benzothiophenes scaffold as novel pan-filovirus entry inhibitors.

title: 791 Cell-intrinsic sex differences shape exhausted CD8 + T cell fate
abstract: Background Biological sex influences immune responses and cancer outcomes. 1 2 Previous studies have demonstrated sex-specific differences in CD8+ T-cell activation, differentiation, and responses to immunotherapy.3 However, it remains unclear whether these differences are primarily driven by the host environment or by cell-intrinsic programs within T cells themselves. Understanding how T cell sex influences fate after antigen stimulation may provide new insights into optimizing cancer immunotherapies.Methods To determine the impact of biological sex on CD8 + T cell differentiation and exhaustion, we used transgenic CD8+ T cells (P14) expressing a T cell receptor specific to a lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) in multiple syngeneic models sharing a common model antigen. Congenically distinct male and female P14 cells were adoptively transferred into male and female recipients and evaluated in chronic LCMV clone 13 infection and B16F10 melanoma expressing the LCMV glycoprotein. Antigen-specific cells were analyzed by multiparameter flow cytometry and single-cell RNA-sequencing to assess expansion, differentiation, and exhaustion states.Results In both tumor and viral models, male antigen-specific CD8 + T cells exhibited greater initial expansion compared to female cells, regardless of recipient sex. This advantage was associated with increased proliferation and enhanced responsiveness to antigen stimulation. Experiments with both castrated male mice and the ‘Four Core Genotypes’ model mice indicated that this expansion was driven largely by Y chromosome-encoded genes. However, male donor cells also displayed a more differentiated phenotype characterized by lower frequencies of Tcf1+ progenitor exhausted cells, reduced KLRG1+ effector populations, and increased frequencies of terminally exhausted CD101+ cells. Notably, these differentiation patterns were maintained across both male and female hosts, suggesting that donor-cell-intrinsic sex-specific programs contribute substantially to exhaustion fate decisions.Conclusions Our findings demonstrate that donor sex influences both the magnitude and differentiation state of adoptively transferred CD8 + T cells in different exhaustion models. Male donor cells expand more efficiently but exhibit accelerated progression toward terminal exhaustion. These observations suggest that intrinsic sex-dependent programs shape T cell fate following adoptive transfer and may represent an important consideration for the optimization of allogeneic cell-based immunotherapies.References Conforti F, Pala L, Pagan E, ... Sex-based dimorphism of anticancer immune response and molecular mechanisms of immune evasion. 2021;27(15):4311–4324.Philip M, Schietinger A. CD8+ T cell differentiation and dysfunction in cancer. 2022;22(4):209–223.Layug P.J, Vats H, Kannan K, Arsenio J. Sex differences in CD8+ T cell responses during adaptive immunity. WIREs Mechanisms of Disease 2024;16(5):e1645.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand how biological sex influences CD8+ T cell differentiation and exhaustion, addressing a knowledge gap in the field of immunotherapy and cancer outcomes.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study used transgenic CD8+ T cells expressing a T cell receptor specific to lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) in multiple syngeneic models, evaluating male and female cells in chronic LCMV infection and B16F10 melanoma models.
analysis.methods: The researchers analyzed antigen-specific cells using multiparameter flow cytometry and single-cell RNA-sequencing to assess expansion, differentiation, and exhaustion states.
analysis.main_results: Male antigen-specific CD8+ T cells exhibited greater initial expansion and enhanced responsiveness to antigen stimulation, but also showed accelerated progression toward terminal exhaustion.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings demonstrate that donor sex influences both the magnitude and differentiation state of adoptively transferred CD8+ T cells, highlighting the importance of cell-intrinsic sex-specific programs in T cell fate decisions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These observations suggest that intrinsic sex-dependent programs shape T cell fate following adoptive transfer and may represent an important consideration for the optimization of allogeneic cell-based immunotherapies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's limitations include the use of a single viral model and the need for further validation in different contexts, but the evidence is strong due to the use of multiple syngeneic models and comprehensive analysis methods.

analysis.summary_en: This study explored how biological sex affects CD8+ T cell differentiation and exhaustion, showing that male cells expand more efficiently but progress faster to terminal exhaustion, highlighting the importance of cell-intrinsic sex-specific programs in T cell fate.

Understanding how T cell sex influences fate after antigen stimulation may provide new insights into optimizing cancer immunotherapies.Methods To determine the impact of biological sex on CD8 + T cell differentiation and exhaustion, we used transgenic CD8+ T cells (P14) expressing a T cell receptor specific to a lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) in multiple syngeneic models sharing a common model antigen. Congenically distinct male and female P14 cells were adoptively transferred into male and female recipients and evaluated in chronic LCMV clone 13 infection and B16F10 melanoma expressing the LCMV glycoprotein. Antigen-specific cells were analyzed by multiparameter flow cytometry and single-cell RNA-sequencing to assess expansion, differentiation, and exhaustion states.Results In both tumor and viral models, male antigen-specific CD8 + T cells exhibited greater initial expansion compared to female cells, regardless of recipient sex. This advantage was associated with increased proliferation and enhanced responsiveness to antigen stimulation. Experiments with both castrated male mice and the ‘Four Core Genotypes’ model mice indicated that this expansion was driven largely by Y chromosome-encoded genes. However, male donor cells also displayed a more differentiated phenotype characterized by lower frequencies of Tcf1+ progenitor exhausted cells, reduced KLRG1+ effector populations, and increased frequencies of terminally exhausted CD101+ cells. Notably, these differentiation patterns were maintained across both male and female hosts, suggesting that donor-cell-intrinsic sex-specific programs contribute substantially to exhaustion fate decisions.Conclusions Our findings demonstrate that donor sex influences both the magnitude and differentiation state of adoptively transferred CD8 + T cells in different exhaustion models. Male donor cells expand more efficiently but exhibit accelerated progression toward terminal exhaustion. These observations suggest that intrinsic sex-dependent programs shape T cell fate following adoptive transfer and may represent an important consideration for the optimization of allogeneic cell-based immunotherapies.References Conforti F, Pala L, Pagan E, ... Sex-based dimorphism of anticancer immune response and molecular mechanisms of immune evasion. 2021;27(15):4311–4324.Philip M, Schietinger A. CD8+ T cell differentiation and dysfunction in cancer. 2022;22(4):209–223.Layug P.J, Vats H, Kannan K, Arsenio J. Sex differences in CD8+ T cell responses during adaptive immunity. WIREs Mechanisms of Disease 2024;16(5):e1645.
abstract_zh: 背景 生物学性别影响免疫应答和癌症结果。1 2 之前的研究已经显示出cd8+ t细胞激活、分化以及对免疫治疗的反应存在性别特异性差异。3 然而,这些差异主要是由宿主环境还是t细胞本身的细胞内程序驱动,仍不清楚。了解t细胞性别如何影响抗原刺激后的命运,可能为优化癌症免疫治疗提供新的见解。方法 为了确定生物学性别对cd8+ t细胞分化和耗竭的影响,我们使用了表达特定淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(lcMV)t细胞受体的转基因cd8+ t细胞(p14)在多个共基因模型中进行研究,这些模型共享相同的模型抗原。遗传背景不同的雄性和雌性p14细胞被移植到雄性和雌性受体中,并在慢性lcMV克隆13感染和表达lcMV糖蛋白的b16f10黑色素瘤模型中进行评估。通过多参数流式细胞术和单细胞rna测序分析抗原特异性细胞,以评估其扩增、分化和耗竭状态。结果 在肿瘤和病毒模型中,雄性抗原特异性cd8+ t细胞无论受体性别如何,都表现出比雌性细胞更大的初始扩增。这种优势与更高的增殖能力和对抗原刺激更强的反应性相关。使用去势雄性小鼠和“四核心基因型”模型小鼠进行的实验表明,这种扩增主要由y染色体编码的基因驱动。然而,雄性供体细胞也表现出更成熟的表型,特征是tcf1+祖细胞耗竭细胞频率较低,klrg1+效应细胞群体减少,以及终末耗竭cd101+细胞频率增加。值得注意的是,这些分化模式在雄性和雌性宿主中均保持不变,表明供体细胞内固有的性别特异性程序在耗竭命运决定中起着重要作用。结论 我们的研究结果表明,供体性别影响不同耗竭模型中移植cd8+ t细胞的扩增程度和分化状态。雄性供体细胞扩增效率更高,但向终末耗竭状态进展更快。这些观察结果表明,内在的性别依赖性程序在移植后塑造t细胞命运,并可能成为优化同种异体细胞免疫治疗的重要考虑因素。参考文献 conforti f,pala l,pagan e,... 抗癌免疫应答的性别差异及免疫逃逸的分子机制。2021;27(15):4311–4324.philip m,schietinger a. cd8+ t细胞分化和功能障碍在癌症中的作用。2022;22(4):209–223.layug p.j,vats h,kannan k,arsenio j. 在适应性免疫过程中cd8+ t细胞反应的性别差异。wires mechanisms of disease 2024;16(5):e1645.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解生物性别如何影响CD8+ T细胞的分化和耗竭,填补免疫治疗和癌症结果领域中的知识空白。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究使用了表达针对淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV)特异性T细胞受体的转基因CD8+ T细胞,在多个共源模型中评估雄性和雌性细胞在慢性LCMV感染和B16F10黑色素瘤模型中的表现。
analysis_zh.methods: 研究人员通过多参数流式细胞术和单细胞RNA测序分析抗原特异性细胞,以评估其扩增、分化和耗竭状态。
analysis_zh.main_results: 雄性抗原特异性CD8+ T细胞表现出更强的初始扩增和对抗原刺激更强的反应性,但也显示出向终末耗竭状态进展更快的趋势。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,供体性别影响移植CD8+ T细胞的扩增程度和分化状态,突显了细胞内固有性别特异性程序在T细胞命运决策中的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些观察结果表明,内在的性别依赖性程序在移植后塑造T细胞命运,并可能成为优化异体细胞免疫治疗的重要考虑因素。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括仅使用单一病毒模型,以及需要在不同背景下进一步验证;然而,由于使用了多个共源模型和全面的分析方法,证据是强有力的。

title: 779 SLAMF7 downregulation in CD8 T cells delineates terminal exhaustion and associates with advanced disease in renal cell carcinoma
abstract: Background T cell exhaustion is a dysfunctional state that arises under persistent antigenic stimulation, such as in chronic viral infection and cancer. Although immune checkpoint blockade can reinvigorate exhausted T cells, only a subset of patients responds, highlighting the need to better define the molecular programs that distinguish functional from terminally exhausted T cells. SLAMF7 is an immune-regulatory receptor; however, its regulation and functional relevance during CD8 T cell exhaustion remain unclear.Methods We analyzed SLAMF7 expression and CD8 T cell differentiation across multiple experimental and clinical settings, including in vitro activation of mouse and human CD8 T cells, acute and chronic lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus (LCMV) infection, murine tumor models, and human renal cell carcinoma (RCC). Phenotypic, transcriptional, and functional features of SLAMF7-expressing and SLAMF7-deficient exhausted CD8 T cell populations were assessed and correlated with clinicopathologic features in RCC patients.Results SLAMF7 was absent in naïve mouse and human CD8 T cells but was rapidly induced upon activation. Following acute LCMV infection, SLAMF7 was broadly expressed by effector and memory CD8 T cell subsets, with higher expression in more differentiated cytolytic populations. In contrast, under persistent antigenic stimulation, SLAMF7 was highly expressed in progenitor and transitory exhausted CD8 T cells but was downregulated in PD-1hi terminally exhausted cells. Loss of SLAMF7 expression coincided with increased inhibitory receptor and TOX expression, attenuation of cytotoxic programs, and impaired polyfunctional cytokine production. Across models, SLAMF7 loss reflected prolonged antigen exposure rather than antigen burden. In RCC patients, SLAMF7-based stratification delineated distinct immune states: SLAMF7-HI tumors retained progenitor-like CD8 T cells with preserved effector function, whereas SLAMF7-DN tumors were enriched for terminally exhausted CD8 T cells and were more frequently associated with high nuclear grade.Conclusions These findings identify SLAMF7 downregulation as a conserved feature of terminal CD8 T cell exhaustion across chronic infection, tumor models, and human RCC. SLAMF7 may serve as a biomarker of CD8 T cell immune competence and disease severity in solid tumors ( figure 1).Abstract 779 Figure 1Graphic abstract

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解SLAMF7在CD8 T细胞耗竭中的作用,应对在慢性病毒感染和癌症背景下更好地定义区分功能性与终末性耗竭T细胞的分子程序的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及分析CD8 T细胞中SLAMF7的表达情况,包括小鼠和人类CD8 T细胞的体外激活、急性与慢性淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV)感染、小鼠肿瘤模型以及人类肾细胞癌(RCC)。
elements_zh.methods: 通过表型、转录和功能特征评估SLAMF7的表达和CD8 T细胞分化。研究包括小鼠和人类CD8 T细胞的体外激活、急性与慢性LCMV感染、小鼠肿瘤模型以及人类RCC。
elements_zh.main_results: SLAMF7在小鼠和人类初始CD8 T细胞中缺失,但在激活后迅速上调。在急性LCMV感染后,SLAMF7在效应和记忆CD8 T细胞亚群中广泛表达,且在更分化、具有细胞毒性的群体中表达更高。相反,在持续抗原刺激下,SLAMF7在祖细胞和短暂耗竭的CD8 T细胞中高度表达,但在PD-1hi终末性耗竭细胞中下调。SLAMF7表达的丧失与抑制性受体和TOX表达的增加、细胞毒性程序的减弱以及多效性细胞因子产生的受损相关。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现确定了SLAMF7的下调是慢性感染、肿瘤模型和人类RCC中终末性CD8 T细胞耗竭的保守特征,表明SLAMF7可能作为实体瘤中CD8 T细胞免疫能力及疾病严重程度的生物标志物。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,SLAMF7的下调可用于对RCC患者的免疫状态进行分层,可能有助于识别病情更严重的患者,并指导治疗策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用非随机的临床样本以及需要在更大的队列研究中进一步验证。由于研究的观察性质,其证据强度中等。

abstract_zh: 背景 T细胞耗竭是在持续抗原刺激下出现的一种功能失调状态,例如在慢性病毒感染和癌症中。尽管免疫检查点阻断可以重新激活耗竭的T细胞,但只有部分患者对此有反应,这凸显了需要更好地定义区分功能性与终末性耗竭T细胞的分子程序的重要性。SLAMF7是一种免疫调节受体;然而,其在CD8 T细胞耗竭过程中的调控和功能相关性尚不清楚。方法 我们分析了SLAMF7表达和CD8 T细胞分化在多种实验和临床环境中的情况,包括小鼠和人类CD8 T细胞的体外激活、急性与慢性淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV)感染、小鼠肿瘤模型以及人类肾细胞癌(RCC)。评估了SLAMF7表达和缺失的耗竭CD8 T细胞群体的表型、转录和功能特征,并将其与RCC患者的临床病理特征相关联。结果 SLAMF7在小鼠和人类初始CD8 T细胞中缺失,但在激活后迅速上调。在急性LCMV感染后,SLAMF7在效应和记忆CD8 T细胞亚群中广泛表达,且在更分化、具有细胞毒性的群体中表达更高。相反,在持续抗原刺激下,SLAMF7在祖细胞和短暂耗竭的CD8 T细胞中高度表达,但在PD-1hi终末性耗竭细胞中下调。SLAMF7表达的丧失与抑制性受体和TOX表达的增加、细胞毒性程序的减弱以及多效性细胞因子产生的受损相关。在各种模型中,SLAMF7的丧失反映了长期抗原暴露而非抗原负担。在RCC患者中,基于SLAMF7的分层揭示了不同的免疫状态:SLAMF7-HI肿瘤保留了具有保留效应功能的祖细胞样CD8 T细胞,而SLAMF7-DN肿瘤则富含终末性耗竭的CD8 T细胞,并且更常与高核分级相关。结论 这些发现确定了SLAMF7的下调是慢性感染、肿瘤模型和人类RCC中终末性CD8 T细胞耗竭的保守特征。SLAMF7可能作为实体瘤中CD8 T细胞免疫能力及疾病严重程度的生物标志物(图1)。摘要 779 图1 图形摘要

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解SLAMF7在CD8 T细胞耗竭中的作用,应对在慢性病毒感染和癌症背景下更好地定义区分功能性与终末性耗竭T细胞的分子程序的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及分析CD8 T细胞中SLAMF7的表达情况,包括小鼠和人类CD8 T细胞的体外激活、急性与慢性淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒(LCMV)感染、小鼠肿瘤模型以及人类肾细胞癌(RCC)。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过表型、转录和功能特征评估SLAMF7的表达和CD8 T细胞分化。研究包括小鼠和人类CD8 T细胞的体外激活、急性与慢性LCMV感染、小鼠肿瘤模型以及人类RCC。
analysis_zh.main_results: SLAMF7在小鼠和人类初始CD8 T细胞中缺失,但在激活后迅速上调。在急性LCMV感染后,SLAMF7在效应和记忆CD8 T细胞亚群中广泛表达,且在更分化、具有细胞毒性的群体中表达更高。相反,在持续抗原刺激下,SLAMF7在祖细胞和短暂耗竭的CD8 T细胞中高度表达,但在PD-1hi终末性耗竭细胞中下调。SLAMF7表达的丧失与抑制性受体和TOX表达的增加、细胞毒性程序的减弱以及多效性细胞因子产生的受损相关。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现确定了SLAMF7的下调是慢性感染、肿瘤模型和人类RCC中终末性CD8 T细胞耗竭的保守特征,表明SLAMF7可能作为实体瘤中CD8 T细胞免疫能力及疾病严重程度的生物标志物。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现表明,SLAMF7的下调可用于对RCC患者的免疫状态进行分层,可能有助于识别病情更严重的患者,并指导治疗策略。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性包括使用非随机的临床样本以及需要在更大的队列研究中进一步验证。由于研究的观察性质,其证据强度中等。

title: 797 Granzyme A is critical for the cytotoxic function of exhausted CD8 + T cells
abstract: Background CD8 + T cell exhaustion is a major contributor to the persistence of cancer. While cancer immunotherapies target exhausted T cells, response rates remain highly variable. Strengthening T cell cytotoxicity is an important strategy for improving T cell-targeted therapies, yet pathways of T cell-induced cell death, including the roles of individual granzyme effector molecules, remain poorly characterized in the context of exhaustion.Methods To understand mechanisms of CD8 + T cell-mediated cytotoxicity, we performed a systematic analysis of granzyme usage in multiple human tumor types by single-cell RNA-sequencing, flow cytometry, and multiplex ELISA, which revealed high expression of granzyme A (GzmA) in exhausted CD8+ T cells. To mechanistically dissect the role of GzmA in the differentiation and function of exhausted T cells, we generated a novel murine Gzma-/- model by CRISPR/Cas9. We adoptively co-transferred both Gzma knockout (KO) and wild-type (WT) donor T cells into WT recipient mice infected with chronic lymphocytic choriomeningitis virus to explore the cell-intrinsic effects of GzmA deficiency over longitudinal progression of T cell exhaustion.Results In human head and neck squamous cell carcinoma 1 and meningioma tumors, we found that GzmA is the dominant T cell effector molecule expressed by tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells. Multiplex ELISA of tumor homogenate confirmed high levels of GzmA protein present in the tumor microenvironment. elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在了解颗粒酶A(GzmA)在CD8+ T细胞耗竭中的作用,探讨癌症免疫治疗反应率的变异性。背景 CD8+ T细胞耗竭是癌症持续存在的主要因素,尽管免疫治疗针对耗竭的T细胞,但反应率仍存在高度变异性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究通过CRISPR/Cas9技术生成了一种新型小鼠Gzma-/-模型,并将Gzma敲除(KO)和野生型(WT)供体T细胞共转移至感染慢性淋巴细胞脉络丛脑膜炎病毒病毒的WT受体小鼠中,以探讨GzmA缺乏对T细胞耗竭纵向进展的细胞内固有效应。此外,本研究还利用单细胞RNA测序、流式细胞术和多重ELISA技术分析了多种人类肿瘤类型中颗粒酶的使用情况。
elements_zh.methods: 方法包括生成Gzma-/-小鼠模型、T细胞的主动转移以及利用单细胞RNA测序、流式细胞术和多重ELISA分析人类肿瘤中颗粒酶的使用情况。多重ELISA证实了肿瘤微环境中颗粒酶A蛋白的高表达水平,单细胞RNA测序显示GzmA敲除与野生型耗竭T细胞之间存在基因表达差异。
elements_zh.main_results: 在人类肿瘤中,GzmA被发现是T细胞效应分子中的主导者。GzmA敲除(KO)T细胞与野生型(WT)T细胞相比,细胞毒性能力存在41%的缺陷,而GzmA KO细胞中GzmB的表达则被上调。这些发现确立了GzmA在耗竭性CD8+ T细胞中作为细胞毒性的重要介质。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将GzmA定义为CD8+ T细胞耗竭中T细胞细胞毒性的关键介导因子,强调其在癌症免疫治疗中的重要性。GzmA在人类肿瘤浸润T细胞和小鼠耗竭T细胞中均高度表达,其敲除实验表明,在T细胞耗竭过程中,颗粒酶是协调调控的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现将对改善癌症免疫治疗中T细胞细胞毒性策略起到关键作用,因为GzmA是耗竭T细胞中不可或缺的细胞毒性效应分子。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用小鼠模型以及需要在人体样本中进一步验证。由于使用了非人类模型且需要更多的临床研究,证据强度为中等。
